name: Compression
description: Low-gap compression detector. Computes the C_long/C_short conviction substrate (Heikin-Ashi body, EMA fan gain/loss, ADX/DI, climate temp, volume spike) and enters ONLY when gap=|C_long-C_short| sits in the low band [min_gap,max_gap] with ADX<=max_adx; direction = sign(C_long-C_short). Tags low_gap_long / low_gap_short.
notes: OWNS the perception substrate (populate_indicators) — Ownership and HarvestSleeve are NOT independent of this genome: both read C_long/C_short/gap/adx and recompute entry_signal_present from min_gap/max_gap/max_adx. SEAM IMPURITY: confirm_trade_entry's champion/slot rule (max 1 long + 1 short; block opposite while a position is between TP1 and TP3) is a portfolio-management gate riding on the entry hook.

name: Ownership
description: Thesis-persistence full-exit core (custom_exit). Continuously re-reads Timmy's own directional conviction (aligned_bias) over a rolling vote window and exits decisively on sustained opposite bias, very-stale misalignment, giveback from the MFE high-water mark, thesis decay, or opportunity-cost reset. populate_exit_trend is intentionally empty (no signal exits). Hard stoploss -3% and ownership trailing stop (armed after +20% offset) are freqtrade-native.
notes: REQUIRES use_exit_signal=True or custom_exit never fires (the v2->v3 boundary). HARD DEPENDENCY on Compression's perception columns (C_long/C_short/gap/adx) and on the v2_* trade-lifecycle custom_data maintained by HarvestSleeve. NOT graftable onto a foreign entry that does not produce C_long/C_short and maintain v2_* state — the §9.3 non-separability made concrete.

name: HarvestSleeve
description: Dynamic conviction-sized scale-out (adjust_trade_position). Depletes the first harvest_sleeve_pct of the position across up to max_harvest_chunks events (TP1/2/3), sized by live alignment state (weak/neutral/opposite) and age; never DCAs/adds. Owns the shared thesis-persistence engine that Ownership also reads (_timmy_read, alignment state, rolling bias-vote window, MFE high-water mark, entry-conviction baseline, age buckets, cooldown). Preserves the v1 EliteExpectationModel + winner-path online learning (on_trade_exit) as supporting telemetry.
notes: REQUIRES position_adjustment_enable=True. Owns the shared re-eval state machine Ownership consumes, so the two are tightly coupled through the v2_* custom_data lifecycle. Shares Compression's perception-substrate dependency.

name: Expansion
description: Fused dual-direction expansion detector. LONG = 'Symphony': price above the Ichimoku cloud across a multi-timeframe trend stack + bullish trend stack + FGI-scaled fan_magnitude_gain. SHORT = 'Jorts/Wanda': red candle + body_pct + volume spike + DI spread + close-below-fast-MA + FGI fear filter + fan_magnitude_loss + red streak. Both sides share the fan_magnitude / Ichimoku perception substrate and Fear-&-Greed scaling.
notes: OWNS the perception substrate (populate_indicators) + the external Fear & Greed Index fetch. COMPOSITE CANDIDATE: this is really two entry organs (Symphony long + Jorts/Wanda short) fused into one slot; a future schema with composite entries should split them. SEAM IMPURITY: confirm_trade_entry's per-side slot gating (max 9/side; slots 4-9 need green-count + a tier winner; slot-3 delayed ignition) is portfolio management riding the entry hook — it lives in the SlotGovernor management genome.

name: ChampionLadder
description: Rank-based, profit-only exit (custom_exit). Never sells red (exit_profit_only=True; no hard stoploss). Per side, power-ranks open trades: ranks 1-3 are scalpers exited on a side-specific dynamic ROI (dynamic_roi_hit); ranks 4-9 are champions with a boosted dynamic-ROI target (champ_dynamic_roi_hit) and a champion trailing stop-profit that tightens on negative velocity (champ_trail_rankN). The family-specific 'champion exits'.
notes: HARD DEPENDENCY on SlotGovernor's live per-side power-ranking (_power_ranks_side) and velocity telemetry (_telemetry), which require the full Trade.get_open_trades() portfolio view — NOT per-trade custom_data. So ChampionLadder is not graftable onto an entry that does not run the SlotGovernor ranking engine. Requires use_exit_signal=True + use_custom_exit=True; relies on exit_profit_only=True (no red exits). Champion-exit tags are tracked as family telemetry only (not league-wide grades).

name: SlotGovernor
description: Per-side portfolio governor. Enforces the slot ladder (max 9 trades/side; slots 1-2 free; slot-3 delayed ignition that arms at 2 trades and re-arms on 3->2; slots 4-9 gated on a green-count + tier-winner extremity ladder). Maintains the per-side power-ranking + EWMA velocity telemetry that ChampionLadder consumes. Also holds the profit-siphon partial-exit ladder in adjust_trade_position (partials_enabled defaults to 0 — inert unless turned on).
notes: Couples to ChampionLadder (exit) and Expansion (entry gate) through PORTFOLIO-LEVEL state: Trade.get_open_trades() per-side sets, in-memory _telemetry / _ignition / _partials_done dicts keyed by trade.id, and closed-trade PnL (_side_total_pnl_abs). This is the distinct seam flavor vs Timmy (per-trade custom_data). The slot-3 ignition also reads external FGI. position_adjustment_enable=True; the partial ladder is dormant by default.

name: Ignition
description: Compression->expansion ignition detector on 1m. Builds volume/range/ATR/momentum baselines, flags a 'quiet' compression regime, then fires 'ignition' on the FIRST expansion candle (composite expand_score >= 1.5 + min move) after recent compression, with a 2-candle cooldown. Enters long/short on a readable directional ignition bar with range still contracted. No custom enter_tag string (enter_long / enter_short only).
notes: OWNS the perception substrate (populate_indicators). The exit (IgnitionHarvest) re-reads one column (expansion_event) best-effort but degrades gracefully when the dataframe is absent, so the coupling is far looser than Timmy/Cosmo. No shared custom_data, no portfolio state — the most graftable entry genome traced so far.

name: IgnitionHarvest
description: Crude time/profit cap on an ignition (custom_exit). Scalp: harvest >+1.2% within 5 min (ignition_scalp). Runner: >+2.5% after 5 min (ignition_runner). Hard 20-minute observation cap recycles a stale ignition (ignition_time). Best-effort fade: early underwater exit if expansion died (ignition_fade) + an 8-minute flat-and-dead time-out. Hard stoploss -3%.
notes: REQUIRES use_exit_signal=True or custom_exit never fires (a prior bug held trades ~110h). exit_profit_only=False (will exit red, unlike Cosmo). This exit is the Pliers' headline 'Exit Damage' (+1306 ExitDamage, ~400x ChurnAmp): the 20-minute cap + immediate re-ignition churns the position. Duration/profit only depend on trade state; the single expansion_event read is best-effort, so this exit is much more graftable than Timmy's Ownership.

name: Classifier
description: Post-event hypothesis classifier. After a big swing (event_move / window_range), a priority cascade assigns exactly one prediction as the enter_tag: regime_change (strong aligned trend), mean_reversion (fade an RSI extreme), deadcat (counter-trend bounce in an intact opposing trend), continuation (momentum persists), or base_building (volatility collapsed into a forming range). The enter_tag IS the prediction the exit later grades.
notes: The entry prediction and the exit's live outcome read share the same indicator substrate and the _hypothesis() reducer, so the Entry->Exit confusion matrix (Event Cartography) can score prediction accuracy. The enter_tag is durable per-trade state the exit reads.

name: ActResolver
description: Thesis-quality behaviour model (custom_exit). Grants a winner GRACE to run with no profit ceiling while its entry thesis stays high-quality (trend still favours the side AND profit near peak); banks it — classified by what the market BECAME (one of five *_exit reads, with Tier-1 deadcat sub-tags) — when the move turns or stalls past a volatility-scaled give-back. Bounds: a max-hold timeout (second_act_timeout), a -5% circuit breaker (second_act_stop), and a -5.5% hard stop. exit_profit_only=True.
notes: REQUIRES use_exit_signal=True. Reads the trade's enter_tag (Classifier's prediction) to split deadcat_invalidated from a base_building entry — so ActResolver is coupled to Classifier through the enter_tag, not custom_data. Breakeven-arm / give-back uses freqtrade max_rate/min_rate excursion. No fixed take-profit anywhere.

name: Breakout
description: Donchian-channel breakout with heavy trend/volume confirmation: close beyond the 15-bar channel +/- 0.2*ATR, ADX>30 with rising slope, post-squeeze, volume spike AND surge, strong directional body, an RSI band, not over-extended, and ROC confirmation. A classic momentum breakout entry — high-conviction, low-frequency.
notes: Pure perception->trigger entry; no shared custom_data or portfolio state.

name: RoiLadderStop
description: Freqtrade-NATIVE exit only: a time-decaying minimal_roi ladder (5% immediately, 2.5% after 30m, 1% after 60m) plus a -3% hard stoploss. There is NO custom_exit and use_exit_signal is False — Roadrunner authors no exit logic of its own.
notes: use_exit_signal=False, so the Pliers exit_off variant is IDENTICAL to baseline -> ExitAlpha=0. This genome is the trivial native exit, the control against which authored exits are measured. Fully graftable (it depends on nothing); the Pliers tagged Roadrunner a 'Stop-Loss Bleeder'.

name: PreExpansion
description: Composite entry: fires only when BOTH agree — (1) Cosmo/Wanda's Expansion signal triggers on this candle, AND (2) a Timmy-style Compression analysis of the ~6 candles immediately preceding the move would itself have favoured the SAME direction. 'What was Timmy saying just before this expansion?' Fewer, higher-conviction entries.
notes: COMPOSITE of two existing entry organs: Expansion (cosmo-wanda) + Compression (timmy), the latter applied as a pre-expansion confirmation gate on the 5m frame. A future composite-entry schema should link both parents; for now parent_genome_slug = mono-the-turners and this note records the lineage. This is the audit's headline example that the genome model finally makes The Turners' real description sayable (Entry: Expansion + Compression).
